## Change / 修改內容

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility limits.

## Validation / 驗證

List the commands actually run and their results. Distinguish fixtures from real OS / application tests. Attach sanitized UI screenshots when relevant.

## Safety / 安全

Confirm that no personal configuration, credentials, compiled package, or generated build cache is included. Explain any change to process identity checks, confirmation, backups, update verification, or legacy behavior.
